# mcrl service

[Command reference](README.md)

Manage services.

```text
Aliases:
  service, services
```

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| [`service create`](#mcrl-service-create) | Create a service |
| [`service delete`](#mcrl-service-delete) | Delete a service |
| [`service list`](#mcrl-service-list) | List services |

## mcrl service create

Create a service.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl service create <name> [flags]

Aliases:
  create, new

Create a service. Names are 2 to 63 letters, digits, "-" and "_", and
cannot start with "-" or "_".

API: POST /api/v0/services
API key permission: Read, Write

Examples:
  mcrl service create web
  mcrl service create batch --memo 'nightly jobs'

Flags:
      --memo string   memo
```

## mcrl service delete

Delete a service.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl service delete <name>

Aliases:
  delete, rm

Delete a service. Its roles, service metrics, monitors and graph
annotations are deleted with it.

API: DELETE /api/v0/services/<name>
API key permission: Read, Write

Examples:
  mcrl service delete old-service
  mcrl service delete old-service --yes
```

## mcrl service list

List services.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl service list

Aliases:
  list, ls

List services.

API: GET /api/v0/services
API key permission: Read

Examples:
  mcrl service list
  mcrl service list --jq '.[].name'
```
